House Classics · Adventure

The Sea Hawk (1924)

An English nobleman sold into slavery escapes to become a Barbary pirate king — real ships and ship-to-ship combat; the silent swashbuckler at full sail.

Directed by Frank Lloyd · Adventure · Silent
Content rating: General · Original aspect 1.33:1

Adventure · Silent · General

Watch

Plays from its own shelf at the Internet Archive (item: my-movie_202006) — the house hosts no film files. Shown in its original shape, pillarboxed on the big screen: never cropped, never stretched.
